svg.title: The Sahel
svg.desc: Situation map covering 19.5°W to 25.0°E, 7.5°N to 28.0°N. A reference plate: where the Sahara ends, and the river that runs into it. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; GMTED2010-derived texture-shaded relief.

g.text: S A H A R A
A reference plate: where the Sahara ends, and the river that runs into it
Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer
Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; GMTED2010-derived texture-shaded relief
The final boundary between the Republic of the Sudan and the Republic of South Sudan has not yet been determined.
